But what about four and four? Maria didn't know. So she asked Mom. Her mom said, "Four and four are eight!" Maria was happy. "I'm four years old now," she said. "In a few years, I'll be eight." Maria is good at learning. She learns fast.

In four more years, I will be eight." Maria learns fast. She doesn't take a long time to learn new things.
